name: Claude Rip Run
hook: Prompt faster before the corporate copyright strike nukes the terminal
tagline: A sleep-deprived indie dev feeds forbidden prompts into Claude to bootleg retro classics before legal ninjas swarm the room. Cashing out exports a legally distinct open-source demo to itch.io under an alias. Crashing brings down a gigantic red DMCA cease-and-desist gavel that smashes the monitor into smoking pixel dust.
